scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || exit 0
scripts.docs:dev: bun run scripts/build.ts --no-declarations && bun run docs:packages && bun run --cwd docs dev
scripts.docs:build: bun run build && bun run docs:packages && bun run --cwd docs build
scripts.docs:build:prod: bun run docs:packages && bun run docs:published && bun run --cwd docs build
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run check-deps && bun test && bun run build && bun run check-size
